name: Shikaku
author: DansiDanutz
summary: Split the grid into rectangles. Each holds one number: its size. First to finish wins.

choices.label: Easy
choices.note: Smaller blocks. A wrong block is marked.

choices.label: Hard
choices.note: Bigger blocks. Nothing tells you that a block is wrong.

howto: Split the whole board into rectangles.
Each rectangle holds exactly one number, and that number is its size.
Both players solve the same board. The first to finish wins.
